about_the_game:
In Cake UP, you will play as a cake courier who delivers an order to the king, in the midst of a magical war. He finds himself on a fierce battlefield of two magicians who do not pay attention to a small courier. The poor guy is trying to get around obstacles and bandits, and he's also worried about the safety of the cake, otherwise the customer will be furious.

The player tries on the role of a courier who wants to do his job during the battle of two magicians.

GAME FEATURES:

  • Deliver the order to the final destination.

  • Dodge the spells that threaten you.

  • Various types of spells flying around the arena, which you will have to deftly avoid.

  • Dropped a piece of cake? Get up off the ground! No one has canceled the five-second rule!

  • Collect the cupcakes scattered on each level.

  • Dodge all the spells and collect all the cupcakes to get the highest score.

  • Unlock levels as you progress.

  • Fight unique bosses at the end of each location.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 64-bit windows 10
  • Processor: i5-i8th Gen CPU or similar
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 950 or Radeon HD7970
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: These are tentative and not final.

short_description: Play as a cake courier who delivers an order to the king in the midst of a magical war! Dodge the magic projectiles, deliver the cake safely and try not to fall into the clutches of the evil cake robbers!
